metadata.title: Home
metadata.description: Product landing page with services, social proof, answers to common questions, and contact details.

blocks.heading: Ship a polished site without starting from zero
blocks.subtext: This template stacks hero, services, testimonials, FAQ, and contact in one scroll — swap copy and theme, then publish.

items.title: Strategy
items.description: Clarify positioning, messaging hierarchy, and conversion goals before design or build work begins.

items.title: Design systems
items.description: Reusable sections and tokens so every page stays consistent as you add tenants and variants.

items.title: Static delivery
items.description: Fast, cache-friendly pages generated at build time — ideal for multi-tenant static hosting.

items.name: Jordan Lee
items.quote: We replaced a patchwork of one-off landings with this structure. Updates are JSON-driven and reviewable.

items.name: Sam Rivera
items.quote: The block order matches how we already pitch: hook, proof, objections, then contact. Less rewriting for us.

items.name: Priya Shah
items.quote: FAQ before contact cut repetitive tickets. We just tuned the copy per brand and shipped.

items.question: Can I override this page per client?
items.answer: Yes. Template pages are defaults; files under config/clients/{clientId}/pages/ with the same slug replace or extend what you see here.

items.question: Do I need a separate contact route?
items.answer: No. This template keeps contact on the homepage. You can still add a dedicated contact slug in the client if you prefer.

items.question: How do I change colors and fonts?
items.answer: Point the client theme at a preset in theme-presets or override individual theme fields in client.json.
